name: Stelexaras Camps App
description: A management system for summer camps. It helps camp staff (HR and management team leaders) track children's organisation, staff and camp structure (e.g. tents, communities) in real time

name: Spotify Songs Tracker
description: SpotifySongsTracker helps users track their favorite Spotify playlists and songs. The app uses Spotify's OAuth for authentication, and users must provide their own credentials.

name: UEFA Ranking App
description: FootballRankings tracks rankings based on European UEFA club matches across the 3 main competitions. This project is for non-commercial use!

name: Greek Müncheners
description: A website for the Greek community in Munich, built with Blazor. It has a calendar with upcoming events, a list of the community's WhatsApp groups, a contact form and a history of past events

name: VolleyBall Notie
description: A Python scraper that checks the public HTML content of a volleyball match website and notifies us via email about new matches

name: Emergy
description: SOS application (Xamarin Forms) for users who get lost, with a municipal-service application (WPF) to find them

name: Thesis
description: University thesis: In this research, we analyze and present the application of the Universal Language Model Fine Tuning technique (ULMFiT) in some text categorization applications, developed by NLP's fast.ai

name: MyEncryptedMessaging
description: Cloud Security - A simple attempt at encrypted messaging. We encode and decode the message with a real timespan trick
